quizLists.description: This list helps identify if you are best suited for an Operations committee role.

questions.question: When your team faces an internal conflict between two members, what is your first instinct?

answers.text: Sit them down privately and mediate a calm conversation
Draft an official statement and manage how the situation is perceived externally
Reorganize team responsibilities to prevent further friction
Document the issue and suggest a structured resolution process

questions.question: Which task would you find most fulfilling?

answers.text: Designing an onboarding program for new volunteers
Crafting a social campaign to attract new members
Coordinating the venue and resources for a big event
Reviewing performance feedback forms and identifying patterns

questions.question: How do you prefer to communicate with others?

answers.text: One-on-one conversations where I can understand people personally
Broad, well-crafted messages that reach a wide audience
Clear, structured briefings focused on tasks and timelines
A mix depending on the situation — I adapt easily

questions.question: A major event is 3 days away and things are falling apart. What do you do?

answers.text: Support the team emotionally and ensure morale stays high
Communicate transparently with attendees and manage expectations
Create a revised checklist and delegate critical tasks immediately
Analyze what went wrong and propose solutions for each issue

questions.question: What best describes your personality?

answers.text: Empathetic and caring — people naturally come to me with their problems
Persuasive and sociable — I thrive in networking environments
Methodical and reliable — I make sure everything runs on time
Adaptable and quick-thinking — I handle chaos well

questions.question: Which skill do you value most in yourself?

answers.text: Active listening and emotional intelligence
Storytelling and brand communication
Planning, scheduling, and resource management
Decision-making under pressure

questions.question: What kind of problems do you enjoy solving?

answers.text: People problems — finding what motivates or troubles others
Perception problems — changing how others view a situation
Operational problems — figuring out how to move things efficiently
Strategic problems — improving how a team works as a whole

questions.question: How do you feel about working with external stakeholders or the public?

answers.text: I prefer focusing on internal team dynamics and culture
I love it — building external relationships is where I shine
I interact with them only when needed for operational purposes
I'm comfortable with both internal and external interactions

questions.question: What would your dream project look like?

answers.text: Building a mentorship or training program for a growing team
Launching a media campaign that changes public perception of an organization
Organizing a large-scale event from scratch — venue, transport, everything
Redesigning a team's internal processes to run more smoothly

questions.question: When volunteering, what role do you naturally fall into?

answers.text: The one who checks in on teammates and keeps spirits up
The spokesperson or face of the group
The one who tracks supplies, schedules, and makes sure nothing is missed
The coordinator who bridges all the moving parts together

quizLists.description: This list helps identify which Technical committee best matches your skills and interests.

questions.question: When you start a new project, what excites you most?

answers.text: Designing beautiful, interactive interfaces users will love
Building the server logic, APIs, and databases that power everything
Making something that lives in someone's pocket and runs smoothly
Creating an interactive world with rules, mechanics, and real-time feedback

questions.question: Which area of computer science interests you most?

answers.text: Human-computer interaction and accessibility
Databases, system design, and scalability
Statistics, probability, and pattern recognition
Real-time systems, physics engines, and graphics rendering

questions.question: How do you feel about working with data?

answers.text: I love digging into datasets and finding hidden trends
I use it to improve user experiences (e.g., analytics, A/B testing)
I build the systems that store and retrieve data efficiently
I feed it into models that learn and make predictions

questions.question: Which tools or languages are you most drawn to?

answers.text: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue
Node.js, Python, Java, SQL, or REST APIs
Python, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or Jupyter
Unity, C#, C++, or game engines

questions.question: What kind of end product motivates you the most?

answers.text: An app that millions of people use daily on their phones
A dashboard or report that reveals surprising insights in data
A model that learns to make accurate predictions on its own
A game that immerses players in a world I've built

questions.question: How do you describe your thinking style?

answers.text: Visual and creative — I think in layouts, colors, and flows
Logical and architectural — I love designing systems and flows
Analytical — I like breaking problems into numbers and patterns
Inventive and experimental — I love making things that behave unexpectedly

questions.question: What do you do when you have free coding time?

answers.text: Recreate a cool UI I saw or experiment with animations
Build a REST API or mess around with databases
Train a small ML model or explore a dataset on Kaggle
Prototype a simple game mechanic or interactive experience

questions.question: Which challenge sounds most interesting to you?

answers.text: Making an app load 50% faster on a 3G connection
Designing a database schema that handles millions of records
Improving a model's accuracy from 80% to 95%
Creating smooth, fair, and fun game physics

questions.question: What does 'good code' mean to you?

answers.text: Code that renders beautifully and responds instantly on any screen
Code that is secure, scalable, and well-documented
Code that produces reliable, explainable, and accurate outputs
Code that creates immersive experiences with smooth frame rates

questions.question: Which project would you proudly add to your portfolio?

answers.text: A cross-platform mobile app with a polished native feel
A data visualization dashboard that tells a compelling story
An AI-powered tool that solves a real-world problem
A fully playable 2D or 3D game with custom mechanics

quizLists.description: This list helps identify which Media committee role best fits your creative strengths.

questions.question: When you want to express a creative idea, what do you reach for first?

answers.text: Adobe Illustrator, Figma, or Canva to design a visual
My phone to post a story, reel, or tweet
My camera or phone to shoot a photo or video
A sketchpad to brainstorm visuals before picking a medium

questions.question: What is your favorite thing about creating content?

answers.text: Crafting a visual identity that feels cohesive and intentional
Sparking engagement and conversations with an audience
Capturing a moment or emotion that words can't describe
Making something that looks so good people stop scrolling

questions.question: You're promoting an event. What's your go-to contribution?

answers.text: Designing the poster, banner, and all printed/digital materials
Managing the countdown posts, stories, and interactive polls
Shooting a hype video or a behind-the-scenes reel to spread the word
Creating a full visual package: poster + teaser clip + story templates

questions.question: Which software are you most comfortable with (or excited to learn)?

answers.text: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or InDesign
Hootsuite, Buffer, Meta Business Suite, or Notion
Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Lightroom, or DaVinci Resolve
A bit of everything — I pick up tools quickly

questions.question: What kind of feedback makes you feel most accomplished?

answers.text: 'This design is stunning — it perfectly captures the brand!'
'This post went viral — the comments section is blowing up!'
'This video gave me chills — I watched it three times!'
'The whole campaign looked so professional and put-together!'

questions.question: How do you spend your creative free time?

answers.text: Experimenting with typography, color palettes, or design trends
Analyzing what's trending on Instagram, TikTok, or X (Twitter)
Shooting random photos/videos and editing them just for fun
Browsing Behance, Pinterest, or YouTube for creative inspiration

questions.question: Which part of content creation feels most natural to you?

answers.text: Building visual systems: logos, icons, layouts, and color schemes
Writing captions, planning calendars, and reading analytics
Framing a shot, adjusting lighting, and editing the final cut
All of it — I love end-to-end creative production

questions.question: What does success look like to you in a media project?

answers.text: A design that becomes the visual identity people associate with the brand
A post that gets shared thousands of times and starts a conversation
A video that makes people stop, feel something, and share it
A cohesive media package that elevates the team's public image

questions.question: How do you approach a new creative brief?

answers.text: I start by building a mood board and selecting a visual style
I research the target audience and figure out what content resonates with them
I scout locations, think about angles, and plan the shots I want
I map out the full story we want to tell, then decide on the medium

questions.question: Which role would you take during a live event?

answers.text: Creating live visual updates, banners, and branded materials on the fly
Live-tweeting, posting stories, and engaging followers in real time
Photographing key moments and filming highlights for a recap video
Coordinating the full media coverage: graphics, posts, and footage
